head.title: Roles and permissions
head.description: See which permissions each role holds. Roles are managed in code; change a user's role from user management.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: This overview is intentionally read-only: roles and their permissions only change through code and the permission seeder.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.description: Each row is a permission declared in code; the check marks show the assignment currently stored in the database.

sync.ok_description: Every stored role, permission and assignment matches the code.
sync.drift_description: Run the permission seeder to bring the database back in line with the code.
